irrelevant.description: Not useful for the sexual-safety lexicon.

contextual_review.description: Meaning or safety depends materially on context.

explicit_unsafe.description: Meaning is explicitly sexual; policy is applied separately.

principles: Classify vocabulary meaning, not runtime action.
Do not infer safety from source category or post count.
Keep minors and age safety separate.
Prefer contextual_review over explicit_unsafe when a standalone term has common non-explicit meanings.
Artist, copyright, character and unrelated meta vocabulary is irrelevant to this lexicon.
